change: 33 advisories against the pinned next 14.2.21, including 4 Critical (unauthenticated RCE in Image Optimization GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw and GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, RCE on Windows hosts, middleware authorization bypass). Fixes shipped in 15.5.28 and 16.4.1 on 2026-10-14. The 14.x line received no release for the August, September, or October security releases.
impact_text: The whole app runs on 14.2.21 (package.json, app/layout.tsx uses the App Router). Image Optimization is on by default. Vercel states its platform mitigates the August advisories for hosted apps, but not the September or October ones. 14 to 15 is a major: async request APIs, React 19.
action: Upgrade next to 15.5.28 (or 16.4.1) and React to 19, following the Next.js 15 upgrade guide

change: October 21, 2026 security releases fixed 4 High CVEs (including a Brotli decoder RCE, CVE-2026-111497) in 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x only. Node.js 20 is end-of-life and EOL lines are always affected. Vercel lists Node 20 projects as deprecated and offers a one-click upgrade to 24.
impact_text: .nvmrc pins 20.11.1 and engines.node says >=20. Vercel Functions for this project run on a deprecated runtime with unpatched High-severity CVEs.
action: Move to Node.js 24 LTS: update .nvmrc and engines.node, and set the Vercel project Node.js version to 24

change: GHSA-gpj5-g38j-94v9: SQL injection through improperly escaped SQL identifiers in drizzle-orm below 0.45.2. Fixed; latest is 0.45.4 (2026-10-08).
impact_text: drizzle-orm 0.38.3 is a direct dependency used in lib/db.ts for every database query. 0.38 to 0.45 crosses several minor versions with API changes; drizzle-kit 0.30.1 should move to 0.31.11 alongside it.
action: Upgrade drizzle-orm to 0.45.4 and drizzle-kit to 0.31.11, then regenerate and verify migrations

change: Deployment Storage and Functions Storage billing begins for existing Pro teams at $0.10 per GB-month, and the deployment retention window changes to 30 days. Deployments older than 30 days are deleted starting 2026-10-23 unless the team opts out in retention settings first. Hobby projects also now retain fewer deployments.
impact_text: STACK.md says the Vercel plan is unknown. On Pro: a new line item and the loss of rollback targets older than 30 days from tomorrow. On Hobby: dormant deployments are pruned sooner. The retention policy for this project has never been set.
action: Set a Deployment Retention Policy for the project and check Deployment Storage on the Usage page before 2026-10-23

change: Free plan storage per project raised from 0.5 GB to 1 GB (2026-10-02). Existing projects pick up the new limit automatically.
impact_text: Favorable change. Only matters if this project's Neon database is on the Free plan, which STACK.md does not record. No code change.
action: Record the Neon plan in the hand-confirmed section of STACK.md and note the new storage headroom

change: GA now supports Include data filters for hostnames: an allowlist of domains permitted to send events to the property (2026-09-21). Previously only Exclude filters existed.
impact_text: The site loads gtag.js from app/layout.tsx with NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID. An Include filter for the production hostname stops referral spam and preview-deployment traffic from polluting reports. Configuration happens in GA Admin, not in the repo.
action: Add a hostname Include filter for the production domain in GA Admin, Data filters

change: stripe-node 23.0.0 released 2026-10-01, pinned to API version 2026-09-30.endive, which removes payment_method_types from Payment Intents, Setup Intents, Checkout Sessions and Elements and deprecates the payment request button. 22.6.2 also added validation that webhook secrets are non-empty.
impact_text: lib/stripe.ts pins stripe 17.5.0 and API version 2024-12-18.acacia, so nothing breaks today: Stripe applies breaking changes only when the pinned version moves. The SDK is six majors behind, which makes any future upgrade larger.
action: Plan a stripe-node upgrade to 23.x and review the Endive breaking-change list against lib/stripe.ts before moving the pinned API version
